variable_format:
Variables live in . A is one of two kinds.
target — the only kind that can be read or written. from source label, e.g. app-sim name display name path required, e.g. /user schema required; every write must conform to it values optional; recommended values for its fields
def — a shared block, never addressed by path. type='def' name source label; targets of this source carry it in their from when global timing rules for those targets desc global writing rules for those targets schema shared types those targets reuse
Rules: 1. Only a target has a path, and only a target is addressable. 2. Never create or set a variable whose path is not a declared target. 3. A def is reference only: it has no path, it is never written, and its schema is not itself a variable. 4. A def's when and desc apply to every target whose from matches the def's name. 5. type='def' is the only special type. Every other is a target and must carry a path.
